We submit this proposal to the Energy Department, Government of Punjab for the design, supply, installation, testing and commissioning of grid-tied Solar PV systems totaling 5 MW across twelve public hospitals, including net-metering approvals, SCADA-based monitoring, staff training, and three (3) years of operations and maintenance (O&M) with performance guarantees.

Our organization has executed multiple solar energy deployments, including a PKR 171M solar project completed in 2024 (10 months) [CAP-032], a Provincial Government solar deployment completed in 2024 (PKR 31M) [CAP-008], and a Federal Government solar deployment completed in 2020 (PKR 34M) [CAP-020]. We also bring experience delivering solutions in the hospital environment through completed Hospital IT deployments for Federal Government (PKR 182M) [CAP-042] and Provincial Government (PKR 66M) [CAP-018], strengthening our ability to plan site activities with minimal disruption to critical care operations.

We hold ISO 9001 certification evidenced on completed international work [CAP-030] and will apply the same quality management discipline to surveys, detailed engineering, civil/electrical execution, testing and commissioning.

Where the RFP mandates specific product and compliance items, we will be transparent: our library does not yet evidence Tier-1 PV modules with 21% minimum efficiency and 25-year linear performance warranty, SCADA central dashboard delivery, DISCO net-metering liaison, IEC 62548/Pakistan Electricity Code compliance, or three-year O&M with performance guarantees; we will address these through named OEM/SCADA/O&M specialist partnering and compliance method statements within our Technical Proposal. Our library also does not yet evidence a PMP-certified Project Manager with 8+ years’ infrastructure experience; we will assign a qualified resource and submit verifiable credentials at contract award.

We will submit the required bid security (2% bank guarantee), FBR active taxpayer documentation, 120-day bid validity, and the required sealed-envelope submission as stipulated in the RFP.
